cairo.note: Downtown and Zamalek generally safe for tourists; standard urban caution advised at night.

giza.note: Pyramid plateau well-patrolled; watch for unofficial guides/vendors near entrances.

alexandria.note: Corniche area well-patrolled; use licensed taxis, avoid isolated beaches after dark.

luxor.note: East Bank tourist areas well-patrolled; West Bank sites remote, travel with a guide.

aswan.note: Generally low-crime; standard precautions for Nile-side areas at night.

hurghada.note: Resort areas secure; desert excursions require licensed operators, heed marine safety briefings.

sharm_el_sheikh.note: Airport and resort zone heavily secured; Naama Bay safe. Avoid Sinai interior without official tour.

dahab.note: Layback town, low crime. Respect local customs; Blue Hole diving only with certified operators.

marsa_alam.note: Remote coastal town; limited medical facilities. Dive with accredited centers only.

el_gouna.note: Gated resort community, very low crime. Medical clinic on-site; nearest hospital in Hurghada.

siwa_oasis.note: Remote desert location; travel in convoy, carry充足的 supplies. Limited mobile coverage outside town.
